description: A Tauri app cross-compiling for Windows on Linux fails while compiling `icons/icon.ico` into a Windows resource file, based on https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/6746.
prompt: I'm cross-compiling our Tauri app for Windows from a Linux CI image and the Rust build gets all the way to the custom build script, then fails with `failed to compile icons/icon.ico into a Windows Resource file during tauri-build: No such file or directory (os error 2)`. The icon path is valid in the repo, so I'm not sure why it is looking in the wrong place.
